text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> HIGH p99 latency alert for text.generate (us-west). p99 > 900ms for 5m, page fired to oncall rotation. Link: https://pd/incident/1861415926. Please ack.
joe: acked. jumping in. any customer-facing reports?
se-prod: we have 3 support tickets reporting timeouts around 15:11 PDT, one timed out at ~30s. SEs are collecting request ids.
eng-runtime: telemetry: request queue depth spiked on gpu-pool-usw-2, KV cache miss rate +40%. tail p99 ~1.2s, p95 ~450ms.
k8s-ops: autoscaler didn't add nodes (quota cap). AWS quota at ~95% usage for that region.
joe: plan: 1) route a portion of traffic to us-east fallback pool 2) reduce max_batch_size 64->16 at sidecars 3) temp model-fallback to redwood-compact for high-latency paths. Starting step 1.
eng-runtime: starting reroute, flipping routing flag `route.usw->useast` (hot).
deploy-bot: routing flag `route.usw->useast` set true by eng-runtime (rev ab12c).
eng-runtime: lowering batcher config, applying `MAX_BATCH=16` to sidecars (rolling restart ~12 pods) — est 90s.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: alert still firing; p99 reduced from ~1.2s -> ~820ms after partial reroute.
se-prod: support update: latency improved for 2 customers; one customer still seeing intermittent ~2s responses.
joe: OK keep monitoring. kicking off KV warmup to prime common prefixes: `./scripts/warmup_common.sh --region=us-west`.
eng-runtime: warmup running, cache hit rate climbing, queue depth stabilizing (metrics: cache_hit +25% in 3m).
k8s-ops: requested temporary quota bump with cloud support; ETA ~20-30m.
eng-runtime: also starting model-fallback rollout: redirecting low-latency class to `redwood-compact` in us-west while heavy requests land in us-east.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by joe. Escalation timer paused.
joe: planning handoff in ~25m to anna (night shift). Handoff summary: `route.usw->useast`=true, batches reduced to 16, warmup running, quota request pending. Impact: user-visible but reduced; continue watching tickets and p99.
anna: ack. I'll take second shift. Ping me on PD when you hand over. I'll keep eyes on SLA, grafana, and support tickets.
joe: handing off now to anna. last observed p99 = ~780ms. Relevant links: Grafana alert https://ourgrafana/alerts/1861415926, runbook: /runbooks/usw-p99-tail. If we don't see steady p99 < 500ms post-quota, escalate to infra and open postmortem.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident reassigned to anna. Thank you for the quick mitigation.
